entries.reason: the layer keeps the value itself, in the category Metal/CAMetalLayer+ExtendedRange16.m beside the neighbouring 11.0 and 11.2 properties, each in an associated object so the layer's own ivar layout is not disturbed. It is not the release's CALayer that answers these six selectors, and that was measured rather than assumed: wantsExtendedDynamicRangeContent, setWantsExtendedDynamicRangeContent:, EDRMetadata, setEDRMetadata:, developerHUDProperties and setDeveloperHUDProperties: are in none of the 113981 selectors of 6.1.3 nor of the 70062 of 4.3; the class list of 4.3 has 7187 names and CAMetalLayer and CAEDRMetadata are 0 of them; and 4.3's CALayer is 249 instance and 10 class methods with none of the six. The name stays on the @dynamic at CAMetalLayer8.m:8 for the other half of the reason: that line is what stops this file synthesising an accessor pair of its own for a property another file answers, and otool -ov on the object confirms the six selectors come from the category
